remarks: Enjoy comfort, convenience, & carefree living in a beautifully remodeled 1-bedroom residence in the desirable Saugatuck Cooperative, an active independent Adult community in Westport. This bright, south-facing unit features a spacious living/ dining area with oversized windows, soaring 9'+ ceilings, & abundant natural light. The separate bedroom offers a spacious walk-in closet, an updated kitchen features new appliances. A full bath w/walk-in shower & stacked w/d provide great convenience. Community amenities include a large community room with kitchen; fitness room; additional laundry facilities; private lower-level lockable storage and beautifully landscaped park-like grounds perfect for relaxing or enjoying a leisurely stroll. Ideally located close to trains, downtown Westport, restaurants, shopping, the library, this home offers exceptional convenience and an outstanding lifestyle opportunity. Common charges include heat, water, sewer, trash removal, snow removal, and grounds maintenance. One resident must be at least 62 years of age. Income guidelines and pet policies apply. Sale is subject to Board approval. Additional photos coming soon.
